Name: Game Modes
Description:
Game modes, game settings and a saved record of how a game was made, for mods that change how Timberborn plays.

On its own it changes nothing: with no mod adding a mode, New Game is the game's own. Mods like [url=https://github.com/FezVrasta/BeaverBuddies-CoOp-PvP-Edition]BeaverBuddies Co-Op/PvP Edition[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3814012422]Timber Empires[/url] add theirs.

[h2]What players get[/h2]
[list]
[*]A Game Mode column on the New Game screens, with a line about what each mode plays like.
[*]Each mod's rules at the end of the Customize list under its own heading: checkboxes, choices, sliders and lists, with Easy, Normal and Hard filling in the values a mod sets for them.
[*]A save's game mode and settings in the Load Game box.
[/list]

[h2]For mod authors[/h2]
[list]
[*]Modes: add one with GameModes.Modes.Add(id, labelLocKey), describe it with Describe, and read the pick as the game loads with Modes.Game.
[*]Settings: toggles, choices, sliders and lists defined under your heading with GameSettings.Group, offered in the modes you pick and read back as typed values.
[*]Records: a game's mode and settings are saved with it and in its metadata, and can be read from a save without loading it.
[/list]
Source and docs: [url=https://github.com/FezVrasta/timberborn-game-modes]github.com/FezVrasta/timberborn-game-modes[/url].
